title: Speed limits
description: Central Government prescribes speed limits; state governments may prescribe lower limits.

title: Traffic signs and signals
description: Drivers must obey traffic signs, signals, and road markings.

title: Motorcycle safety and passenger limits
description: Safety provisions and the penalty for contravening motorcycle passenger-safety rules.

title: Protective headgear
description: Motorcycle riders and pillion riders must follow protective-headgear rules; the penalty section also provides licence consequences.

title: Seat belts
description: The duty and the amended penalty provision for seat belts are displayed together.

title: Excessive speed
description: Reference ranges vary by vehicle class and offence circumstances.

title: Dangerous driving and red-light jumping
description: The 2019 amendment's explanation includes jumping a red light and handheld communication-device use.

title: Drunk driving
description: The amended record distinguishes first- and repeat-offence reference amounts and possible imprisonment.

title: Exceeding permissible weight
description: ₹20,000 plus ₹2,000 per tonne of excess load, with removal of excess load before movement.

title: Excess passengers in transport vehicles
description: ₹200 per excess passenger, with off-loading and alternative transport requirements.

title: Emergency vehicles
description: Up to six months' imprisonment, ₹10,000 fine, or both.

title: Offences by juveniles
description: Guardian/owner liability, up to three years' imprisonment, ₹25,000 fine, registration cancellation, and licence restrictions as applicable.

title: Driving without a valid driving licence
description: Sections 3 and 4 mandate a valid driving licence and minimum age requirements. Section 181 prescribes a fine of ₹5,000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 months for driving without a licence or permitting an unauthorised person to drive.

title: Driving an unregistered vehicle
description: Section 39 prohibits driving an unregistered motor vehicle without a valid Certificate of Registration (RC). Section 192 prescribes a fine up to ₹5,000 (minimum ₹2,000) for a first offence, and up to ₹10,000 and/or imprisonment up to 1 year for repeat offences.

title: Using a transport vehicle without permit
description: Section 66 mandates that transport vehicles must operate under a valid permit. Section 192A prescribes a fine up to ₹10,000 (minimum ₹5,000) and/or imprisonment up to 6 months for contravention.

title: Driving an uninsured vehicle
description: Section 146 requires mandatory third-party insurance coverage for all motor vehicles. Section 196 prescribes a fine of ₹2,000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 months for a first offence, and ₹4,000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 months for repeat offences.

title: General traffic offences, dangerous parking, and obstruction
description: Section 177 prescribes a general fine of ₹500 for traffic rule contraventions where no specific penalty is provided. Section 122 prohibits leaving vehicles in hazardous positions, and Section 201 imposes ₹500 per hour for causing obstruction to traffic flow.

title: Violation of road safety and pollution standards (PUC)
description: Section 190(2) penalises operating a motor vehicle in violation of prescribed emission or pollution standards (Pollution Under Control) with a fine up to ₹10,000 and/or driving licence suspension for 3 months.
